hook: In October 2026, the AI market saw 64 distinct price moves.

sections.voiceover: In October 2026, the AI market saw 64 distinct price moves.
sections.visual_cue: Large bold text showing 64 price moves on a dark background.
b_roll: Abstract data points shifting on screen

sections.voiceover: API providers like Anthropic and Mistral implemented 18 price cuts while raising costs 46 times. These 64 price moves include 18 cuts and 46 increases across the AI API market.
b_roll: Bar chart comparing 18 cuts to 46 increases

sections.voiceover: Except Claude Haiku 5.5 dropped to $0.10, a massive 90% reduction.
sections.visual_cue: Close up of the $0.10 price point.

sections.voiceover: Mistral Large 4 slashed output prices by 50 percent on October 30, 2026, for users. With 8 models facing retirement, developers must track these changes to their current AI tools.
sections.visual_cue: Graph showing the price drop for Mistral Large 4.

sections.voiceover: By October 30, 8 AI models received official retirement notices from their respective developers.
